title: Native shared family observations
description: Use the private authenticated gateway and owned native device, with explicit FARMSLOT_HOME/FARMSLOT_RUNS_DIR, orchestration disabled and a fresh FARMSLOT_NATIVE_RUN_RECEIPT. Two private fixtures have no task, slot, workspace, worker or session. A second client cancels only the active fixture; teardown removes both. Family summaries and recipe groups stay in memory; selected full-run details persist.

proofTargets.claim: The actual family screen observes its selected full run and both recipe groups, and a second-client cancellation updates the visible family state without Refresh.
A cold offline family route restores the exact selected full-run observation from SQLite, opens its actual detail through Open saved run, and recovers family and recipe observations after reconnect.
A plain family route records the selected run in its actual navigation parameters, and the cold proof reopens that saved route.

prepare.intent: Seed a unique two-run family before restarting the private gateway.

observe.intent: Observe the actual native family and use a second client to cancel its owned active run.

notification-proof.intent: Require current shared family, selected full run and both recipe-group observations.

visible.intent: The actual family cockpit renders the externally cancelled selected run.

cold.intent: Cold restart the real app while the private gateway is stopped, inspect persisted selected detail and reconnect.

cold-proof.intent: Require exact saved observation time, actual saved-run link and current family/recipe recovery.

cleanup.intent: Remove only the two unique private fixtures.

before.intent: Start the native recording before fixture setup and external changes.

default-route.intent: Open a plain family link and require the actual default selection to appear in its route.

default-proof.intent: Require the selected full run to be preserved by the application navigation state.
